identity: A Mesoamerican armor of Nahuatl origin, somewhat similar to a European gambeson.  It is made of unspun cotton between two layers of quilted cotton crystallized by brine, edged with leather around its holes.  It is extremely thick and offers superb protection, but is also heavy.  This bad boy once stopped Spanish bullets and Aztec missiles alike, now its time has come to stop zombie bites.

entries.developer_comments:
~ NPC dialogue line
~ This Exodii is named Venn.  You've met before.  Venn and the Autodoc will
do some serious work on you.  They'll take out all of your important organs
and stick them in a Cyberframe, like these.  It will take a long time.  We
can offer you one of two basic Cyberframes.  If your mind is set on doing
this, you can pick.
identity:
&Rubik makes a stiff, bowing gesture and leads you out of the shop and down a stone pathway towards a familiar building - the gloomy surgical suite.  Rubik greets the humanoid cyborg that operates the suite, then stares a long moment in wordless communication.  The cyborg brings out a bulbous CRT monitor with a wired mechanical clicker, which they hand to you.  Rubik's joints hiss as they crouch to view the screen with you.

"This'ere Exodii monicked Venn.  Ye've met'afore.  Venn'n'the'robot here'll do you somethin' fierce.  They'll carve out all yer important meat bits, and stick'em in a Cyberframe, like this'n.  It'll take time.  Lots'o'time.  We've the means for two basic frames.  If yer lump is set, ye can pick."

Rubik gestures to the glowing terminal.  Displayed is an outline of what looks like a human.  Beside it are two other outlines.  The first, which Rubik calls "one-aye," looks a lot like Rubik himself.  It towers over the human shape, and can only be called humanoid.  Its center mass is a thick, squat shape, with the head and torso hard to distinguish from one another.  The second, which Rubik calls "one-bay," looks slender, traced by hard, mechanical lines, but is nevertheless distinctly human-like.

identity: This one's for the nostalgic, I suppose, like Venn here.  You'll still have a human shape, and can still do and wear all your human things.  Downside is it can't be plated as well, so it's a bit more vulnerable by itself.

identity: Blend in to the forests and urge them to speed your passage.  Trees bend out of the way, bushes do not hinder you, and even grass subtly moves your feet along.  The ritual must be enacted in the forest and will fail if you pass out from beneath the boughs.
